name: Healer's Errand
description: Dr. Vasik needs bioluminescent moss from the deep crypts to treat Pvt. Tannis. The Old Keeper below the outpost knows where it grows.

talk_to_keeper.label: Talk to the Old Keeper
talk_to_keeper.description: Descend into the crypts below Outpost Balor's basement and find the Old Keeper. He knows where the bioluminescent moss grows.

completionActions.text: The Old Keeper knows exactly where the moss grows. Into the Bone Chamber.

find_moss.label: Find the Bioluminescent Moss
find_moss.description: Descend to the Bone Chamber — the second level of the crypt — and harvest the bioluminescent moss from the far wall.

completionActions.text: You found the moss. Get it back to Dr. Vasik quickly.

return_to_vasik.label: Return the Moss to Dr. Vasik
return_to_vasik.description: Bring the bioluminescent moss back to Dr. Vasik in the outpost infirmary.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: Healer's Errand. Tannis will recover. Dr. Vasik has taught you to craft Field Medkits.
